publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: English quality component composite for generated resource-quality profiles and evaluation evidence from the audited default English component graph. It does not claim corpus-scale quality baselines, readability scoring, style diagnostics, OCR/noisy-text diagnostics, annotation adjudication, or complete Wikidata dump coverage.
